notes.title: 7/21/25 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Thanks to Bees on the Steam forum, I learned that the Emergency Bracelet is scuffed and it refuses to delete itself when it's used, which may lead to you getting in a situation where you're dying over and over with no escape. As such, it no longer does anything and it's no longer sold. Added a new conversation with Devon outside the vending machine to yap about it.
[*] Finally properly fixed turning in the cult quest multiple times. Hopefully.
[*] Did a little buff for Jasper. People aren't likely to use their magic skill, so I decided to give it a little more oomph: since there's only two sources to inflict Burning - and one of them is temporary and the other is from a prize you have to go out of your way for - Jasper's ability now inflicts Burning.
[*] To balance that out, the Spare Nametag no longer has its downsides and gives immunity to Burning.
[*] I did not realize I zeroed out the loan you have to pay after you beat Hannah because I lazily copied things for when you pay legitimately. Nah, you gotta pay up eventually. You just won't get chased for it.
[*] Working for the Knife now has a hard cap at 999. I didn't realize how truly busted it can be because I don't have the min-maxxing mentality.
[*] Raised HP of some late game bosses.
[*] Certain animation in alt route now properly centered. ^u^
[*] Zeroed out notoriety after you reach a certain point in the alt route.
[*] Updated credits.
[/list]

notes.title: The Fishing Minigame Update
notes.content:
In honor of the Turn Based Fest, I've updated the game... with something completely self-indulgent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44707157/9d3ef7669cccf472c61f5b2c96f8ef7f188221a1.png[/img]

In 2018, I made a duology of freeware games called Fishing Minigame on itch, though the second one's more important. Fishing Minigame 2 was the first game made for the shared universe of Slimes and I Hate You, Please Suffer. And now, it's here for a wider audience - an edited version of the game is accessible through this one!

With some edits, commentary from the IHYPS cast, and some lore changes to be more consistent with this game, play as an adventurer that desperately needs a break getting sidetracked by a fishing minigame! There are 4 main endings, 21 side ones... and a whole new one that serves as an epilogue for Fishing Minigame 2 and a certain IHYPS character.

Fishing Minigame is accessible through an arcade machine at that break room floor in the third stratum. Once you get at least one ending, an NPC will spawn in the foyer of the third stratum that can take you straight there for a price.

And some other bits...

[list]
[*] On the alternate route you get a substantial stat boost at some point. However, you also unlock a means to freely get more stats, so I decided to remove that little stat boost.
[*] Box on monster trafficking quest now only properly appears when you get worst outcome on quest.
[*] Seeing the Illusion Shrine all the way through will also give you the gift for Jasper if you had reached that point without recruiting Jasper.
[/list]

Because I was proud of that cutscene you can now access an edited version of it in the Waking Stones since Ramona's apartment is no longer available for it.
[/list]

On a personal note I was asked to participate in [url=https://afterjourneysend.substack.com/p/volume-1-is-out]After Journey's End[/url], a little project collecting postmortems on games. I wrote something, check that out and the writings of other people if you think we're a good cool

notes.title: 2-20 Update
notes.content:
- If you have :) active, enemies get a massive buff at 10 turns to discourage money farming. That's moved up to 13 now, under the consideration that maybe you're just having a tough time.
- Buffed endgame Tower route bosses a bit more, for the sake of making the buying out of lease route more tempting.
- Some flavor text with Uzbek after beating the tower.
- Fixed the game not giving your armor you earned at one point in the alternate route.
- Removed the "Celebrate..." achievement because requiring a whole other playthrough on the alternate route just to get one achievement would be too annoying for completionists. You'll still get the normal in-game reward for doing what it calls for though. I will also take the chance to openly say that all the achievements in the alternate route can be gotten in one playthrough, and you can just reload the last save to get the ending ones.


things i put in previous updates but forgot to mention in past updates so I should mention it while I'm at it:
- Added a little warning clarifying that you're getting locked into the alt route
- If you have Good Vibrations active and have Jasper in your party, enemies instead get Gooder Vibrations, which raises their stats alongside giving an extra turn, since a four member party that can act twice can effortlessly blitz enemies before they can even act once.

notes.title: 1/8 patch notes!
notes.content:
The Saving Contrition
[list]
[*] I forgot that sleeping just dumps Ramona outside her apartment, skipping the switch that locks using the Artifact Gacha/Tarot. That's fixed now.
[*] Since the Waking Stones is largely a safe place, you can open those there now too.
[*] Comments on the saving system made me aware of a specific quirk of RPG Maker: if you're playing a common event within an event and save, reloading cancels out the rest of the common event and just continues the rest of the base event, which explains some of the weirdness people reported. As such, those events will save twice as a failsafe.
[*] Autosave added for (hopefuloly) every big milestone in the third tier quests since they're larger than the others.
[/list]

Other Fixes
[list]
[*] Can't get bounty office info on a few guys that get got offscreen.
[*] Game now properly asks you whether or not you want to buy the hint for The Controller, so now Patrick no longer robs you in return for unsolicited advice.
[*] Party properly reappears after disappearing for a cutscene.
[*] Emperor and Judgement can properly only be used in battle
[*] 3rd stratum chest in the casino should properly work now lol
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*] To go along with the saves added to the lighthouse, leaving the lighthouse secretly gifts you money if you're below fare so you could safely call a ride home to prevent dying on the way home and leaving you stuck in a potentially softlocked game.
[*] Ambush encounters disappear during briefing at the harbor so nothing can potentially interrupt the cutscenes.
[*] Some of you mentioned an unusable skill for Devon called "Please Shut Up." I thought about it and well, I decided to remove it altogether. Its utility was that it was a stance that'd raise his physical attack, but I realized a) Kyrie already has the physical attacker niche b) most people got on fine without it, so why not just remove it entirely?
[/list]
